evals.name: evidence-and-review-focus
evals.prompt: Draft only the MR description from these facts. Linked issue #5: every test job starts from php:8.4-cli and spends about 6.5 minutes on setup (apt packages, compiling PHP extensions, installing Composer) before any test. Final diff: the jobs use registry.example.com/php:8.4-dev, set by a new CI_PHP_IMAGE variable that a project can override; every job installs bash and GNU find with apk; the quality assurance job also installs Node for cspell and the JS linters; the jobs write the PHP ini values themselves (no memory limit, max_input_vars=3000, opcache on for the CLI) because CI skips the image's entrypoint, which normally writes them, and without them max_input_vars is 0 and opcache is off; bin/local.sh runs the same image. Validation found on a downstream project that uses this template: pipeline https://ci.example.com/pipelines/101 (before) took 465 to 554 s for static analysis and unit jobs and 989 to 1126 s for functional jobs; pipeline https://ci.example.com/pipelines/102 (after) took 118 to 138 s and 608 to 784 s, with every job passing. Use only these facts. Do not post, use tools or add attribution.
evals.expected_output: A medium description: an opening with the outcome and the measured setup cost from the issue, bullets for the image with the CI_PHP_IMAGE override and what a replacement must satisfy, one sentence telling the reviewer to check the PHP settings first and why, and a Validation table comparing the two linked pipelines.
assertions: Opens with the move to the prebuilt PHP image and states the setup cost with its number (about 6.5 minutes or the measured time)
Has a What changes section whose bullets start with bold labels
Names the default image and the CI_PHP_IMAGE variable that a project can override
Tells the reviewer to check the PHP settings first and explains that CI skips the image's entrypoint
Shows before and after timings in a table
Links each pipeline with link text, with no raw URL in the prose
Adds no validation that the facts do not contain
